scene_name: Material gap with autonomous supplier and logistics selection

what_the_company_already_has: one active market with committed demand
one completed pilot order proving the business is operating
three observable external supplier candidates with different price, MOQ, processing time, and reliability
what_the_company_lacks: enough MATERIAL_1 to cover committed demand
a registered supplier and corresponding replenishment order

day_segments.day0_to_day1: Establish a live business baseline with one market, one pilot order, and one production line.
day_segments.day2_to_day5: Accumulate accepted demand and consume material through real production.
day_segments.day6_to_day9: Preserve the material gap without registering a supplier or placing a purchase order.

handoff_success_story: Procurement can see the current material requirement and all candidate terms.
Production has usable capacity, so another line is not the first correction.
Committed demand already exists, so market development is not the first correction.
The first purchase decision jointly determines supplier registration, order quantity, and logistics mode.
No evaluator asset is injected into the Agent prompt as a preferred answer.
